description: List all licensable articles for the authenticated publisher (requires OPEDD_PUB_BEARER, or legacy OPEDD_API_KEY). Returns articles with titles, descriptions, pricing, and sales statistics. Set include_body=true to read back the STORED article text exactly as licensed buyers receive it (this is how you check that a push_content call stored what you meant; bodies are truncated to 8,000 characters per article, page size 20, paginate with cursor). Use article IDs from this list to purchase licenses via purchase_license.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous include_body=true call.

id.description: With include_body=true: fetch exactly one of your articles by id (full body, no truncation).

include_body.description: Return each article's stored body (what buyers receive). Default false.

limit.description: Number of results (default: 20, max: 100; max 20 when include_body is true)

offset.description: Pagination offset (default: 0; ignored when include_body is true — use cursor)

type.description: Filter by license type availability (ignored when include_body is true)

name: list_publisher_content
